description: This file defines the Round class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing PHP implementations of various numeric rounding functions such as round, roundup, rounddown, mround, even, and odd, including support for array-based inputs.

classes.name: Round
classes.description: Provides PHP implementations of various rounding functions used in calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including rounding to nearest, up, down, multiple, even, and odd.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Returns the number rounded to the specified precision using PHP's built-in round after validation.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Rounds a number up towards positive infinity to the specified number of decimal places, using different methods depending on PHP version.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Rounds a number down towards zero to the specified number of decimal places.

methods.name: multiple
methods.description: Rounds a number to the nearest multiple of a given value.

methods.name: even
methods.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest even integer.

methods.name: odd
methods.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest odd integer.
